crossRefs.keyword: could not speak. Heb. they discerned not to speak. eachpeople. Heb. people and people

people.name: Ashdod
people.line: A major Philistine city, known for Dagon worship.

translations.web: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.
translations.bsb: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or of the other peoples, but could not speak the language of Judah.
translations.kjv: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.
translations.asv: and their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.
